title: 2026 OECD Global Forum on Building Trust and Reinforcing Democracy
discussion_signal: The OECD discussion links low trust to citizens’ sense that they lack a voice and to government difficulty turning complex agendas into tangible outcomes, making responsiveness and delivery central to democratic legitimacy.
linked_research_question: Why do people distinguish having a vote from having an effective say when governments appear unresponsive?
limits: The post presents OECD survey interpretation without country-level detail
Perceived voice does not directly measure institutional responsiveness
Institutional framing may not capture opposition or protest perspectives
